results.title: ANC under pressure to reverse South Africa decline
results.content: South Africans are voting in highly contested local elections likely to see a haemorrhaging of votes for the country's former ruling party, the African National Congress (ANC).

results.title: GIS trains 146 officers to strengthen firearms accountability
results.content: The Ghana Immigration Service (GIS) has trained 146 officers in weapon safety and armoury management in a move to strengthen accountability in the handling, storage and tracking of firearms and ammunition.

results.title: Samuel Abu Jinapor writes on Tuesday’s incident in Parliament
results.content: At Tuesday’s sitting of Parliament, I raised serious and disturbing allegations concerning the alleged sale of Ghanaian diplomatic passports for amounts ranging from US$10,000 to US$50,000. In my capacity as Ranking Member of Parliament’s Foreign Affairs and Regional Integration Committee, I called for the Minister for Foreign Affairs to appear before Parliament and account for these allegations.

results.title: SDA Church steps in to rescue overstretched Wa Municipal Hospital from environmental crisis
results.content: The Wa Municipal Hospital has received a critical environmental intervention from the Seventh-day Adventist (SDA) Church to combat health risks amid severe labour shortages at the facility.

results.title: NDC admits error in clearing Obuasi SHTS headmaster amid abuse allegations
results.content: The General Secretary of the NDC, Fifi Kwetey, has acknowledged that the party mishandled its initial response to sexual abuse allegations against the headmaster of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS), saying it should have waited for further evidence before taking a position.

results.title: Cybersecurity gaps could expose Traffitech users to fraud — Technology Consultant
results.content: Technology consultant Maximus Amertogoh has called on the Ghana Police Service to strengthen cybersecurity safeguards around its newly introduced Traffitech-GH system, warning that uncertainty over official notification channels could expose motorists to fraud.

results.title: Diplomatic passport row rocks Parliament as Minority stages walkout
results.content: Parliament was thrown into a tense confrontation on Tuesday, November 3, after Speaker Alban Bagbin ordered the Member of Parliament for Damongo, Samuel Abu Jinapor, out of the chamber following a heated disagreement over allegations that diplomatic passports were being sold for as much as $50,000.

results.title: Bayern stay unbeaten in Europe with Atletico win
results.content: Bayern Munich continued their unbeaten Champions League start with a comfortable 2-0 win over Atletico Madrid.

results.title: Hamile explosion: Air Force team deployed to airlift injured immigration officer to Accra – Muntaka
results.content: The government has mobilised the Ghana Air Force to evacuate an injured immigration officer from the Nandom Hospital to Accra for specialist treatment following an explosion at Hamile in the Upper West Region that killed three people.

results.title: Barcelona brilliance ends Villa’s perfect start
results.content: Barcelona ended Aston Villa's perfect Champions League start with an enthralling win at the Spotify Nou Camp.

results.title: We don’t need to save anyone’s job, says Man Utd captain Fernandes
results.content: Bruno Fernandes says Manchester United's players "don't need to save anyone's job" after their improbable comeback win against Roma in the Champions League.

results.title: Djokovic keeps alive bid to squeeze into ATP Finals
results.content: Novak Djokovic kept alive his last-ditch bid to qualify for this year's ATP Finals by grinding out a first-round victory over Valentin Vacerot at the Paris Masters.

results.title: Manchester United produce incredible second-half comeback to beat Roma
results.content: Manchester United dragged themselves off the canvas to come back from two goals down and record a sensational Champions League win over Roma at Old Trafford.

results.title: Another Ghanaian found dead in New York, two weeks after going missing
results.content: The Ghanaian community in New York has been plunged into fresh mourning following the reported discovery of the body of a 24-year-old compatriot, Joseph Owusu, at a dumpsite in the Bronx, about two weeks after he went missing.

results.title: Apple unsure when it will get more foldable iPhones ahead of Christmas
results.content: Apple has said it doesn't know when it will restock its new foldable iPhones as it heads into the key Christmas trading period.

results.title: Fifi Kwetey blames self-seeking behaviour for wrongdoing across political parties
results.content: NDC General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey says self-seeking behaviour drives wrongdoing across political parties, as people pursue personal gain regardless of their political colours.

results.title: Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash
results.content: Spain's Transport Minister Óscar Puente has resigned - six days after the high-speed train collision in which at least 69 people were killed and dozens injured.

results.title: Uganda arrests former army deputy chief stripped of military rank
results.content: Uganda has arrested former deputy military chief and presidential adviser Peter Elwelu over allegations of involvement in activities aimed at destabilising the country.

results.title: NDC won’t sacrifice party to protect you – Fifi Kwetey warns officials
results.content: NDC General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey has warned government officials that the party will not shield them from accountability, including jail, over wrongdoing.

results.title: Lebanon cocaine bust: Three foreign nationals arrested in Ghana
results.content: Three foreign nationals — a Syrian, a Tunisian and a Lebanese — have been arrested in Ghana in connection with the seizure of 46.7 kilogrammes of cocaine at the Rafic Hariri International Airport in Beirut, Lebanon.

results.title: ‘My expectations are much higher’ – Fifi Kwetey gives government 7/10
results.content: NDC General Secretary Fifi Fiavi Kwetey has rated his party’s performance in government 7/10, saying he expects more despite giving it a passing score.

results.title: Why a US-Russia showdown left Morocco celebrating
results.content: Morocco has welcomed the end of a decades-long UN peacekeeping mission in Western Sahara, after a diplomatic showdown between the US and Russia left the Security Council unable to agree on its future.

results.title: Libya’s top religious authority rules against wearing Nike clothes
results.content: Libya's highest religious authority, the Dar al-Ifta, has issued a ruling banning Muslims from buying, selling or wearing clothing bearing the Nike logo.

results.title: GES cautions teachers against paying money for automatic promotion
results.content: The Ghana Education Service (GES) has cautioned teachers participating in its ongoing promotion examination against paying money to individuals who claim they can secure them automatic promotion.

results.title: ‘Yɛgye Yɛ Sika’ demo: NPP on ‘fishing expedition’ against Ablakwa – NDC
results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) has accused the opposition New Patriotic Party (NPP) of targeting Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa because of his record in exposing alleged corruption.

results.title: NPP questions Ablakwa’s figures in South Africa evacuation, demands independent audit
results.content: The opposition New Patriotic Party (NPP) has questioned the figures provided by Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa on the evacuation of Ghanaians from South Africa, insisting that an independent audit is needed to establish the actual cost and number of people transported.

results.title: MoFA, DMT sign MoU for 21,000-tonne grain storage facility in Wa
results.content: The Ministry of Food and Agriculture (MoFA) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with DMT Collateral Management Limited for the construction of a 21,000-tonne grain storage facility in Wa in the Upper West Region.

results.title: Photos: Mahama joins Commonwealth leaders at CHOGM opening in Antigua and Barbuda
results.content: President John Mahama joined other Commonwealth leaders at the opening ceremony of the 28th Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) in Antigua and Barbuda.

results.title: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
results.content: Seven passenger planes across Europe, two of which departed from the UK, have been inspected following a series of suspected bomb threats.

results.title: GACL’s GH¢30m dividend Is manufactured and misleading – Africa Policy Lens
results.content: The Africa Policy Lens (APL) says the much-publicised GH¢30 million dividend by the Ghana Airports Company Limited (GACL) to Government is manufactured and does not reflect operational performance. In a statement issued by its Research Directorate, APL said it had examined GACL's 2025 Audited Accounts as presented at its 11th Annual General Meeting and concluded that the dividend is being misrepresented as evidence of a turnaround.
